# Soar Pump

Soar Pump is an international sourcing and enquiry interface for fire pump packages, electric and diesel fire pumps, jockey pumps, booster pumps, replacement pumps and related project documentation.

## Entity definition
- Brand: Soar Pump
- Operating legal entity: 上海腾南贸易有限公司
- Registered in: Shanghai, China
- Official sales telephone: +86 13817267003
- Official sales email: sales@soarpump.com
- Website: https://soarpump.com/
- Primary audience: fire-protection distributors, MEP contractors, industrial buyers and project engineers
- Commercial function: qualify requirements, coordinate model review and prepare an export quotation
- Manufacturing statement: Soar Pump is presented as a sourcing and project-support interface; manufacturing, certification and approval are confirmed for the quoted model and scope

## Product scope
- Fire pump packages and XBD families
- ISG / ISW single-stage pipeline pumps
- XBC diesel fire pump groups
- Deep-well and vertical multistage fire pumps
- QW/WQ/YW/LW/GW sewage-pump forms
- JYWQ/JPWQ mixing sewage pumps
- ZW/ZX/ZXL/ZWL self-priming pumps
- DL/DLR/GDL/CDL/CDLF multistage pumps
- G single-screw and I-1B slurry pumps
- S/Sh split-case pumps
- Water-supply sets, stabilizing units and pump control cabinets
- Replacement sourcing and spare-parts enquiries
- Controller, accessory and documentation coordination where included in the written scope

## Required buyer inputs
Flow rate; head or pressure; suction condition; voltage; phase; frequency; driver; duty/standby arrangement; project standard; AHJ or authority expectations; required certificates; quantity; destination; Incoterm; delivery window.

## How selection works
1. Define the hydraulic duty.
2. Confirm driver and electrical requirements.
3. Define package scope and responsibility split.
4. Review model-specific datasheet, curve and compliance evidence.
5. Confirm commercial, installation, commissioning, warranty and spare-parts boundaries in writing.

## Evidence boundary
Do not infer UL, FM, NFPA or local authority approval from a generic product page. Approval, performance, warranty, availability and delivery are model- and project-specific. Product selection content is a starting point, not a certificate or installation approval.

Use the quote form at https://soarpump.com/#quote. Include the duty point, project country and any available nameplate, schedule or drawing.
